files.README.md:
# jpa-sqlite-repositories-only

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: JPA entities, repositories over an `EntityManager` (Hibernate) and services, in Java 21. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no framework.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: not written.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/main/java/app/Database.java        the EntityManagerFactory of DATABASE_URL, with every entity
src/main/java/app/UnitOfWork.java      the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/java/app/errors/              NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/java/app/entities/            one entity per table
src/main/java/app/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/test/java/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                   what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
mvn test                                          # SQLite in target/
TEST_DATABASE_URL=jdbc:sqlite:app.db?foreign_keys=true mvn test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

`Database.open()` uses the connection pool built into Hibernate, which is fine for trying the code; in production give `Database.configuration(...)` a `DataSource` or a pool such as HikariCP.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <groupId>app</groupId>
  <artifactId>jpa-sqlite-repositories-only</artifactId>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>Data access layer (entities, repositories and services) generated by DB2CRUD.</description>

  <properties>
    <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId>
      <artifactId>hibernate-core</artifactId>
      <version>7.4.15.Final</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId>
      <artifactId>hibernate-community-dialects</artifactId>
      <version>7.4.15.Final</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.xerial</groupId>
      <artifactId>sqlite-jdbc</artifactId>
      <version>3.54.1.0</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
      <version>6.1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.4</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
